entities.summary: Sebastian Theodore Kemble Croft is an English actor and singer. He began his career as a child actor on stage before making his television debut as Young Ned Stark in Game of Thrones (2016). He earned a BAFTA Children's Award nomination for his role in Horrible Histories: The Movie – Rotten Romans (2019). He has since starred in the Netflix series Heartstopper (2022–2024).
